task.title: P6-186: [parked] Residual batch-move TOCTOU and undo not restoring the tray
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Parked — real, deliberately deferred; do not work until its trigger fires). Original id: P6-186. Specs: specs/app-ui.md, specs/collection-api.md.

**The residual batch-move TOCTOU, and undo not restoring the tray** (was `P6-061d` + `P6-061l`; both deliberate and documented). Resolution reads holdings in a transaction separate from `move_batch`'s, so "exactly one candidate" is decided against a snapshot the write does not hold — the tradeoff is accepted at `app-ui.md:1366-1374`. And a successful move clears the tray entries (`move_selection.rs:610`) while undo never re-adds them (`:708-739`).

**Triggers: `move_batch`'s addressing changes or a real double-move is observed; and users read the undo behavior as wrong.**
